verdict.rationale: The only evidence on Bitwarden's integrated authenticator describes standard TOTP: six-digit, SHA-1 codes that rotate every 30 seconds. Nothing in the pack documents Steam Guard codes, HOTP counter-based tokens, or configurable periods and digit lengths. A TOTP authenticator could reasonably offer these, so the axis applies, but there is no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a power user, non-standard tokens work too — Steam Guard, HOTP counters, custom periods and digit lengths
